title: Executable small bias construction data
statement: For a natural number $n$, an executable small bias construction consists of a positive natural number $\ell$ specifying the field degree, an executable binary field model of that degree with its arithmetic tables, and a list of length-$n$ binary output vectors in the fixed ordered-pair seed order.
hypotheses_covered: the field degree is a natural number and is positive
a binary field model for that degree with complete arithmetic tables is provided
a list of binary vectors of length $n$ is provided as the outputs
caveat: The upstream definition of the executable binary field model and the fixed ordered-pair seed order are not supplied.
